Name: Large Void Egg 2
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
Void Chickens now product Large Void Eggs as a deluxe produce similar to how chickens produce larger eggs with higher friendship levels! Works with existing and new Void chickens!

Updating my old mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4656 to work with 1.6 and you can even add the egg to the Mayo Machine for guaranteed Gold quality Void Mayo.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/1VAr1Zc.png[/img]


[size=4][u]Important:[/u][/size]
Base selling price: 125g

[u][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/u]
1) Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2) Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]

[u][size=4]Installation:[/size][/u]
Unzip the downloaded .zip file and place them in your Mods folder
